subproblem.title: Cone claim (10) with the corrected constant b·16ⁿ < a (Simon Ch. 3, proof of 1.6)
subproblem.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^P, E ⊆ ℝ^P, Q : ℝ^P → linear subspaces, T a linear subspace and a, b, δ real numbers with a > 0 and b·16ⁿ < a. Assume ofReal(aρⁿ) ≤ μ(B̄_ρ(y)) for all y ∈ E and 0 < ρ < δ, and μ(X(x) ∩ B_ρ(x)) ≤ ofReal(bρⁿ) for all x ∈ E and 0 < ρ < δ, where X(x) := {z : 2|p_{Q(x)}(z − x)| < |z − x|}. Then for all x, y ∈ E with ‖p_{Q(x)} − p_T‖ < 1/16 and |y − x| < δ/2 we have |y − x| ≤ 4|p_T(y − x)|.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a b δ : ℝ), 0 < a → b * 16 ^ n < a → (∀ y ∈ E, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → ENNReal.ofReal (a * ρ ^ n) ≤ μ (closedBall y ρ)) → (∀ x ∈ E, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → μ ({z | 2 * ‖(Q x).starProjection (z - x)‖ < ‖z - x‖} ∩ ball x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (b * ρ ^ n)) → ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ y ∈ E, ‖(Q x).starProjection - T.starProjection‖ < 1 / 16 → ‖y - x‖ < δ / 2 → ‖y - x‖ ≤ 4 * ‖T.starProjection (y - x)‖
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof, step 7 (Claim (10)); Simon Ch. 3, proof of 1.6, chapter-03.txt lines 227–249, with the corrected constant. Dictionary: with π := T^⊥ and π_x := Q(x)^⊥ we have |p_T v| = dist(v, π), ‖p_{Q(x)} − p_T‖ = d(π_x, π) and X(x) = X_{1/2}(π_x, x) in Simon's form (2); the conclusion says that y ∉ X_{1/4}(π, x) for y ≠ x, which is (10). In the application a = (1 − ε₀)ωₙ and b = ε₀ωₙ with ε₀ = 2⁻¹16⁻ⁿ, so b·16ⁿ = ωₙ/2 < a; with Simon's printed ε₀ = 16⁻ⁿ one would get b·16ⁿ = ωₙ ≥ a and no contradiction (the documented erratum).

1. Suppose the conclusion fails: σ := |y − x| satisfies 4|p_T(y − x)| < σ. Then σ > 0, and σ < δ/2 by hypothesis.
2. B̄_{σ/8}(y) ⊆ X(x) ∩ B_{2σ}(x). Let |z − y| ≤ σ/8. Since z − x = (y − x) + (z − y) and ‖p_{Q(x)}‖ ≤ 1,
  |p_{Q(x)}(z − x)| ≤ |p_{Q(x)}(y − x)| + |z − y| ≤ |p_T(y − x)| + ‖p_{Q(x)} − p_T‖·σ + σ/8 < σ/4 + σ/16 + σ/8 = 7σ/16,
 using |p_T(y − x)| < σ/4 and ‖p_{Q(x)} − p_T‖σ < σ/16. Also |z − x| ≥ |y − x| − |z − y| ≥ 7σ/8 and |z − x| ≤ |y − x| + |z − y| ≤ 9σ/8 < 2σ. Hence 2|p_{Q(x)}(z − x)| < 7σ/8 ≤ |z − x|, i.e. z ∈ X(x), and z ∈ B_{2σ}(x).
3. Since 0 < σ/8 < δ and 0 < 2σ < δ, the hypotheses (with y and with x, both in E) and monotonicity of μ give ofReal(a(σ/8)ⁿ) ≤ μ(B̄_{σ/8}(y)) ≤ μ(X(x) ∩ B_{2σ}(x)) ≤ ofReal(b(2σ)ⁿ).
4. As a(σ/8)ⁿ > 0, the inequality between the ofReal values forces a(σ/8)ⁿ ≤ b(2σ)ⁿ = b·16ⁿ·(σ/8)ⁿ; dividing by (σ/8)ⁿ > 0 gives a ≤ b·16ⁿ, contradicting b·16ⁿ < a. Hence |y − x| ≤ 4|p_T(y − x)|. ∎
proof_key_steps: Assume 4|p_T(y − x)| < σ := |y − x| (so 0 < σ < δ/2).
Density bounds at y and x give a(σ/8)ⁿ ≤ b(2σ)ⁿ = b16ⁿ(σ/8)ⁿ, contradicting b16ⁿ < a.

audit.reason: The strict projection estimates place the entire closed ball inside the open cone and larger ball. The density comparison yields a ≤ b·16ⁿ, contradicting the stated hypothesis. Positivity of the left side justifies removing ofReal without assuming b ≥ 0; no extra positivity assumption on δ is needed.
